decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is a high-value, newly launched system with US release still pending in Q1/2019, so withdrawing it a year later is very unlikely.
Small volume ionization chambers serve the growing small-field dosimetry market and have long product lifecycles in medical physics.
This second small volume chamber complements the firm's detector portfolio, and dosimetry products typically stay on the market for many years.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is a core product with steady demand from radiotherapy clinics.
Chambers for relative dosimetry are routinely used with water phantoms and support system sales, so the firm would keep it.
Thimble chambers are established workhorse detectors with stable demand and regulatory certification already invested.
